input.objective: Identify the exact San Francisco city agency responsible for this issue and the official reporting channel with its URL. Issue category: parking. Prefer official city government pages such as sf.gov and 311.
queries: San Francisco report blocked driveway abandoned vehicle SFMTA 311

value.title: Report blocked driveway or illegal parking | SF.gov
value.excerpt: SFMTA parking enforcement responds to blocked driveways and illegal parking. Abandoned vehicles are reported separately.

value.title: 311 Customer Service Center | SF.gov
value.excerpt: SF 311 is the city's single point of contact for non emergency service requests. Call 311, use the web forms, or use the SF311 mobile app.
